lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Grid-like distribution of high-luminance circular spots arranged in approximately 8-10 identifiable vertical columns in the mid-flank region posterior to the gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, most prominent in the area immediately posterior to the fifth gill slit.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three parallel horizontal linear features running across the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient with higher luminance on the dorsal side of each ridge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A significant V-shaped amputation or tissue loss is present on the posterior trailing edge of the visible pectoral fin; a thin, high-luminance linear mark crosses the gill region and upper flank diagonally.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple small, dark, elongated silhouettes (remoras) clustered beneath the pectoral fin and along the ventral surface.
